assumptions.sentence: The C lowering tool (swdb lower, version 9) lowers the C++ proof unit to C that behaves the same; WP proves the C lowering, not the C++.
clang 22.1.8 parses the C++ proof unit correctly for the C lowering tool.
Frama-C/WP 33.0 generates only sound proof obligations for the C lowering under its memory model and the x86_64 machdep.
Z3 5.1.0 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
CVC5 1.2.1 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
Alt-Ergo 2.6.4 answers valid only for valid proof obligations.
WP treats contract property init_MAA_assigns of init_MAA as Extern: assigns SPD_count, REG_count, region_count;.

WP treats contract property init_MAA_ensures of init_MAA as Extern: ensures
SPD_count ≡ 0 ∧ REG_count ≡ 0 ∧ region_count ≡ 6.
WP treats contract property get_reg_unsigned_int_assigns of get_reg_unsigned_int as Extern: assigns \nothing;.

WP treats contract property get_new_reg_unsigned_int_args1_terminates of get_new_reg_unsigned_int_args1 as Extern: terminates
\false.
WP treats contract property get_new_reg_unsigned_int_args0_assigns of get_new_reg_unsigned_int_args0 as Extern: assigns \nothing;.

WP treats contract property get_reg_unsigned_int_ensures of get_reg_unsigned_int as Extern: ensures
\result ≡ __swdb_dx_reg_words[\old(reg_id)].

WP treats contract property get_reg_unsigned_int_terminates of get_reg_unsigned_int as Extern: terminates
\false.
WP treats contract property get_new_reg_unsigned_int_args1_assigns of get_new_reg_unsigned_int_args1 as Extern: assigns REG_count, __swdb_dx_reg_words[REG_count];.

WP treats contract property get_new_reg_unsigned_int_args1_ensures of get_new_reg_unsigned_int_args1 as Extern: ensures
\result ≡ \old(REG_count) ∧ REG_count ≡ \old(REG_count) + 1 ∧
__swdb_dx_reg_words[\result] ≡ \old(data).
The pinned MMIO implements call semantics including ordering; its wait fence lacks a memory clobber, a portability note independent of candidate artifacts.
A DX100 store remains visible if the snoop filter drops its line before the write reaches L3.
A DX100 store remains visible when L3 passes a write below it because no block can be allocated.
No stale CPU copy survives a DX100 store (owner Eric).
All commands belong to one DX100 instance.

This original partial synthetic unit uses one configured core0 scalar MMIO range of32 four-byte words, with aligned fault-free synchronous mapping, no queued register packet/device command, and no competing CPU/device access from any core through normal return. Initial RF values are unconstrained; both observed cells are overwritten. This conditional environment/source-model premise is owned by the Probata proof-semantics maintainer, pending Yan-Ru freeze review (59). The source casts away volatile on its typed MMIO dereference and mfence has no memory clobber; the certificate binds exact effective source and compiler-emitted effects under recorded flags, not portable MMIO ordering or implementation correctness. The simulator RF raw-byte storage typed access, object-lifetime and alias validity are scoped runtime/compiler TCB premises, not established by native sanitizers. Source/model contract-body agreement remains an owned unverified TCB duty. No hardware termination, freshness, general interference or whole-interface claim follows. Software-counter objects are disjoint from the scalar MMIO range. init_MAA resets only software counters and establishes no RF value or hardware freshness. Each initialized allocation has an ordinary pre-write signed-domain/capacity obligation, 0 <= REG_count <= 31; it is not an environment assumption. The exact original store and fence precede the final capacity assertion. The source/model correspondence and disjoint-address premise remain owned TCB duties pending Yan-Ru freeze review (59).
